steps.title: Transfer first set to column 1
steps.instruction: Transfer the specified volumes from the four source wells of the 384‑well plate into column 1 of the 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL from well A1 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 1 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 2 µL from well A3 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 1 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 2 µL from well A5 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 1 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 20 µL from well A7 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 1 of the 96‑plate.

steps.title: Transfer second set to column 2
steps.instruction: Transfer the same volumes from the next four source wells of the 384‑well plate into column 2 of the 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL from well A9 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 2 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 2 µL from well A11 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 2 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 2 µL from well A13 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 2 of the 96‑plate.
Pipette 20 µL from well A15 of the 384‑plate into the appropriate well of column 2 of the 96‑plate.

steps.title: Repeat across columns
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 1 and 2 for each subsequent destination column until the end of the row of the 96‑well plate is reached.

steps.title: Repeat for additional start wells
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 1‑3 using new starting source wells A2, B1, and B2, proceeding across the row as described above.
